scope: Compact first-use mobile member filter disclosure, preserving explicit native disclosure choices and existing filter/search results across rerender, resize, profile and routes. Frontend presentation-state change only.
implementation: Choose initial disclosure state at first Members render: closed at<=768px,open above768px.
In-memory native toggle choice retained; existing panel snapshot preserved on rerender.
Read current open property synchronously before leaving Members, avoiding deferred-toggle timing loss.
No filter values,payloads,permissions,savedrecords,styles or backend behavior changed.
manual_visual_review: Current Chromium320 full-page compact roster capture; controls and applied-count guidance remain visible.
prototype_findings: Initial test used Overview eyebrow as heading; corrected to actual destination heading.
First production prototype exposed delayed native toggle event losing route-roundtrip choice; fixed by synchronous capture before route teardown and rerun in both environments.
limitations: Saves112-122px at320px;firstmember remains below initial phone viewport. This is one hierarchy improvement,not complete above-fold roster redesign.
All operational filter tests use intercepted memberfixture or real readonlyRAM; no production writes.
In-memory presentation choice only,not persisted across fullreload or account changes.
No nativeAT/physicaldevice certification;not every role/filterstate or every possible navigation boundary.
Historical integrated reports retain source freshness; current focused unit/build/filter gates do not certify entire260plan.
